description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus, tax year 2025: 35 documents (31 PDFs — form instructions and 7 IRS publications — and 4 FTB instruction web pages), 4,997 passages, FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, Haiku contextual summaries, and each document's source file (ref_document_files; ref_documents.format says pdf or html).
_notes: GitHub Release asset (corpus-v4 tag). Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta), so clones running Ollama need no reembed. The source files live in the database, not in git; packages/sources keeps their sidecars. corpus-v4 changed the schema (ref_documents.format, ref_document_files.source): replace an older corpus.db with `npm run corpus -- fetch --force`. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
